title: WPSS/1746/2014 of Nagendra Tiwari Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS No.1746/14
Honíble Rajiv Sharma, J.
 Mr. G.D. Joshi, Advocate, for the
petitioner.
 Mr. Vikas Pandey, Standing
Counsel, for the State.
 Pursuant to the advertisement
dated 1.2.2014, the applications were
invited for filling up the post of Assistant
Teachers throughout the State of
Uttarakhand.
 Petitioner also participated in the
selection process. He secured 63.37786%
marks as per Condition ëAí of the
Conditions annexed with the
advertisement. The petitioner has given
his option to be posted in District U.S.
Nagar.
 Learned counsel for the petitioner
submits that the posts are still lying
vacant in District U.S. Nagar but he has
been given posting in District Almora.
 Accordingly, the petition is disposed
of with the direction to the respondents
to consider posting the petitioner in
District U.S. Nagar, if the post, in
question, is still lying vacant. Petitioner
shall also be entitled to get continuity of
service.
